zep.name: Kirov Airship
zep.description: Massive zeppelins that are the aerial terror of the Soviet force.

orca.name: Harrier
orca.description:
Fast assault fighter.
Cannot be built more than landing pads available.

beag.name: Black Eagle
beag.description:
Aircraft armed with EMP bomb.
Cannot be built more than landing pads available.
Strong vs Buildings, Vehicles
Weak vs Infantry, Aircraft

schp.name: Siege Chopper
schp.description: Helicopter capable of deploying into a long range artillery.

fortress.name: B2 Spirit
fortress.description:
Carpet bomber plane.
Cannot be built more than landing pads available.

havoc.name: Havoc Attack Helicopter
havoc.description: Armored helicopter armed with anti-tank rockets.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.description:
Captures enemy structures, repairs damaged buildings and bridges.
Disarms explosives.

e1.name: G.I.
e1.description:
General-purpose infantry.
Can deploy to gain more range and damage.

ggi.name: Guardian G.I.
ggi.description:
Anti-tank and anti-air infantry.
Can deploy to gain more range.

spy.name: spy
spy.description:
Infiltrates enemy structures for intel or sabotage.
Exact effect depends on the
building infiltrated.

ghost.name: Navy SEAL
ghost.description:
Elite commando infantry, armed with a sub machine gun
and C4 charges.

tany.name: Tanya Adams
tany.description:
Elite commando infantry, armed with
dual pistols and C4 charges.

cleg.name: Chrono Legionnaire
cleg.description:
High-tech soldier capable of erasing enemy units.
Strong vs Infantry, Vehicles, Buildings
Weak vs Aircraft

gren.name: Grenadier
gren.description:
Infantry armed with grenades.
Can kill garrisoned infantry.

lcrf.name: Amphibious Transport
lcrf.description:
General-purpose naval transport.
Can carry infantry and vehicles.

dlph.name: Dolphin
dlph.description: Trained dolphin armed with sonic beams.

adest.name: Assault Destroyer
adest.description:
Heavy vehicle armed with a cannon that can move over both land and water.
Strong vs Vehicles, Ships
Weak vs Infantry, Aircraft

gapowrup.name: Advanced Coolants
gapowrup.description:
Better coolants allow power plants to work more efficently
providing 150 more power.

gawall.name: Allied Wall
gawall.description: Heavy wall capable of blocking units and projectiles.

gagap.name: Gap Generator
gagap.description: Obscures the enemy's view with shroud.

gacsph.name: Chronosphere
gacsph.description:
Allows teleportation of vehicles.
Kills infantry.

atesla.name: Prism Tower
atesla.description:
Advanced base defense.
Can buff at most 3 other Prism Towers nearby.

gagatea.name: Allied Gate
gagatea.description: Automated barrier that opens for allied units.

gamgun.name: Mirage Turret
gamgun.description: Defensive structure that is invisible while not firing.

gagun.name: Gun Turret
gagun.description:
Anti-tank defense structure.
Strong vs Vehicles
Weak vs Infantry, Aircraft

mgtk.name: Mirage Tank
mgtk.description: Tank that appears as a tree while immobile.

bfrt.name: Battle Fortress
bfrt.description: Large vehicle with 5 fireports for infantry in to fire.

robo.name: Robot Tank
robo.description:
Remote controlled vehicle.
Requires an Allied War Factory or Shipyard to operate.

ctnk.name: Chrono Dragon
ctnk.description:
Armed with anti-ground missiles.
Teleports to areas within range.

terror.name: Terrorist
terror.description:
Carries C4 charges taped to his body and kamikazes enemies
blowing them up quickly and efficiently.

deso.name: Desolator
deso.description:
Carries a radiation-emitting weapon.
Can deploy for area-of-effect damage.

ivan.name: Crazy Ivan
ivan.description: Specialist for explosives. Can plant a Bomb on anything, even Cows.

civan.name: Chrono Ivan
civan.description: Specialist for explosives. Can plant a Bomb on anything, even Cows.

boris.name: Boris Bukov
boris.description:
Elite commando infantry, armed with
AKM rifle and signal flare.

hjck.name: Hijacker
hjck.description:
Steals enemy vehicles.
Can infiltrate enemy Battle Labs to gain access to new infantry.

itrp.name: Iron Trooper
itrp.description:
High-tech soldier capable of making friendly vehicles invulnerabile and
damage enemy infantry.

sapc.name: Amphibious Transport
sapc.description:
General-purpose naval transport.
Can carry infantry and vehicles.

sub.name: Typhoon Attack Submarine
sub.description: Submerged anti-ship unit armed with torpedoes.

sqd.name: Giant Squid
sqd.description: Large ocean creature capable of grabbing and sinking ships.

sray.name: Stingray
sray.description:
Light ship armed with dual Tesla Coils.
Can move on land.

nairon.name: Iron Curtain Device
nairon.description:
Grants invulnerability to vehicles and structures.
Kills infantry.

nawall.name: Soviet Wall
nawall.description: Heavy wall capable of blocking units and projectiles.

tesla.name: Tesla Coil
tesla.description:
Advanced base defense.
Can be buffed or made work during low power by Tesla Troopers.

nagatea.name: Soviet Gate
nagatea.description: Automated barrier that opens for allied units.

napost.name: Tesla Fence Post
napost.description:
Defence system that creates an electric fence between 2 fence posts.
Posts also act as small Tesla Coils.
Can be buffed or made work during low power by Tesla Troopers.

naprop.name: Propaganda Tower
naprop.description: Buffs fire speed of nearby units and heals them.

dron.name: Terror Drone
dron.description: Small vehicle that can infect enemy vehicles and slowly kill them.

htk.name: Flak Track
htk.description: Anti-Air and Anti-Infantry vehicle capable of transporting Infantry.

attack.armaments: primary, elite, primary-uranium, elite-uranium, primary-uranium-orange, elite-uranium-orange, primary-cryo, elite-cryo

apoc.name: Apocalypse Tank
apoc.description:
Soviet Advanced Battle Tank with Double Barrel
and Anti-Aircraft Missile Launcher.

attack.armaments: primary, primary2, elite, elite2, primary-uranium, primary2-uranium, elite-uranium, elite2-uranium, primary-uranium-orange, primary2-uranium-orange, elite-uranium-orange, elite2-uranium-orange, primary-cryo, primary2-cryo, elite-cryo, elite2-cryo

ttnk.name: Tesla Tank
ttnk.description: Russian special tank armed with dual small Tesla Coils.

dtruck.name: Demolition Truck
dtruck.description: Demolition Truck, actively armed with nuclear explosives.

deva.name: Devastator
deva.description:
Soviet Advanced Battle Tank with Double Barrel
armed with nuclear warheads

ftnk.name: Flame Tank
ftnk.description: Soviet tank armed with dual flamethrowers.
